entries.quote: A Contextual Side Setback may fall at any point between the required side setback and the side setback that exists on a lot that is adjacent and oriented to the same street as the subject lot, but shall be a minimum of three (3) feet. If the subject lot is a corner lot, the Contextual Side Setback may fall at any point between the required side setback required by the zoning district and the side setback that exists on the lot that is adjacent and oriented to the same street as the subject lot, but shall be a minimum of three (3) feet. If lots on either side of the subject lot are vacant, the setback that is required by the zoning district shall apply.
